declaration.mitigation: Operator-invoked provisioning only (management command prints DDL; nothing runs on deploy, migrate or update). Statements create a read-only definer/principal, a per-principal view database, SELECT grants and RESTRICTIVE row policies; no ALTER/DROP/INSERT on existing tables, no data rewrite. Rollback: DROP the created users, row policies and view database.

Clustering detail and centroid reads now carry the requested project. A mixed or stale detail batch is rejected before centroid creation; memberships use stored trace IDs rather than loading the retired trace relation. The centroid lookup retains its cluster_id predicate and LIMIT 1, adding a bound project_id predicate. The existing project-filtered ALTER TABLE error_embeddings UPDATE deleted = 1 and subsequent reinsertion in mark_embeddings_as_clustered are unchanged, including their existing asynchronous, non-transactional behavior. No schema change or backfill is introduced. Synthetic multi-project query plans and timings are recorded separately; they are not production measurements or full upgrade/restore qualification.
